Policy Changes Frequently. No fix policy.
Promotion policy is not here.
Leaves are very less as comparison to other industries.
11 hrs & 6 day will destroy your life & family.

For 1 hr travel 2-3 seater bus is provided which is uncomfortable. 2*2 seater bus to be provided. 3*2 seater bus is good for small distance travel but for 2 hr daily travel 2*2 is comfortable.
Behaviour of transportation staff is not bad it's worst. They treat employees like labour class people.
Medical Facilities aren't poor they are worst, No doctor available no medical store also available in Township. It's such a huge group atleast basic necessary medicines will be provided in OHC.
Adani school fees are like sky rocket, atleast it should be subsidized or free for employees.
Food Quality at site or even at containers as well as their guest house is below average. Better to avoid.
Only the good thing is there that Salary on time and Air Quality is Excellent.
Employees are also scared that nobody knows about their policy and even permanent employee can be put on third party payroll so beware that before joining..
If you get here 50% rise you will loose your 100% life here and lack of facilities as well as scarcity of TPC roll. 
Better not to switch just for the money because mental peace & stability can't beat any amount.
